def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]

def line_cols(grid):

    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]

def segments(n, lines):
    """The (start, end) index ranges between the given line indices, nonempty."""
    out = []; s = 0
    for L in lines:
        out.append((s, L)); s = L + 1
    out.append((s, n))
    return [x for x in out if x[1] > x[0]]

def cell_blocks(grid):
    """Split the grid by its one-color separator rows/cols into (r0,r1,c0,c1) blocks, with the separator color."""
    rows = line_rows(grid); cols = line_cols(grid)
    rs = segments(len(grid), rows); cs = segments(len(grid[0]), cols)
    line = grid[rows[0]][0] if rows else (grid[0][cols[0]] if cols else None)
    return rs, cs, line

def minority_color(grid, exclude):
    """The least common color of the grid among colors not in exclude (and the most common such)."""
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    cand = [k for k in c if k not in exclude]
    lo = min(cand, key=lambda k: c[k])
    hi = max(cand, key=lambda c_: c[c_])
    return lo, hi

def count_map_blocks(grid, target=None, keep=None, else_=None):
    """Per grid block (split by separator lines): f(count of target-color cells), f(n)=keep if n<keep_n else n-1."""
    rs, cs, line = cell_blocks(grid)

    c = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

    dot = min(cand, key=lambda k: c[k]); bg = max(cand, key=lambda k: c[k])
